name: doit
description: A Claude Code channel for DoiT Cloud Intelligence: tells an open session about new cost anomalies and cloud incidents. Events only; the DoiT tools come from the DoiT Cloud Intelligence plugin or connector.

api_key.title: DoiT API key
api_key.description: Personal API token from the DoiT console (Profile > API tokens). Used to check for new anomalies and incidents.

events.title: Events
events.description: Comma-separated event kinds to push into the session: anomalies, incidents.

poll_seconds.title: Poll interval (seconds)
poll_seconds.description: How often to check the DoiT API for new events. Minimum 60.
